title: Idempotent producer decision
summary: Classifies an incoming batch against the last accepted producer batch. A producer with no last batch appends; a lower epoch is fenced and a higher epoch appends; at the same epoch the batch appends when it continues at the last sequence plus one modulo 2^31, is a duplicate of the last batch when its sequence range matches it, and is otherwise out of order.

forall<accepted: ProducerBatch> last == Some(accepted) && producer_epoch@ == accepted.epoch@ && base_sequence == increment_sequence_model(accepted.last_sequence, 1i32) ==> result == ProducerDecision::Append

title: Compaction retain decision
summary: The single per-record KIP-534 retain decision. Control batches (transaction commit and abort markers) are retained as long as their transaction's data survives and then age out through the delete horizon; data records dedup newest-wins; a tombstone ages out through the delete horizon after it becomes the newest entry for its key.

forall<h: i64> batch.is_control && txn == TxnDataState::DataFullyGone && batch.existing_horizon == Some(h) ==> result == (if now_ms@ >= h@ { RetainDecision::Delete } else { RetainDecision::Keep })

!batch.is_control && rec.has_key && is_newest_for_key && !rec.has_value && batch.existing_horizon == None ==> exists<h: i64> result == RetainDecision::SetHorizon(h) && h@ == compute_horizon_model(now_ms, delete_retention_ms)
